Application Data.NAME: Illuminex Lighting Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Illuminex Lighting Solutions specializes in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality lighting fixtures and supplies for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Our operations include product development, assembling energy-efficient lighting solutions, and providing installation services to ensure optimal performance and customer satisfaction. We also offer consultation services to help clients choose the right lighting systems to meet their specific needs.
